statuses.proposed: Asked for or planned, and not built.

roles.co_counsel_techcenter: Chancellor's Office General Counsel and the CCC Technology Center

integrations.name: MAP custom-report API
integrations.replaces: Hand-saved MAP exports and the master workbook's copies of them.
integrations.note: The daily build pulls the custom reports with the MAP API key; student-grain rows stay on the runner or in reviewer-only tables and reach the page only as counts.

integrations.name: COCI course and program catalog
integrations.replaces: Reading each college's course and program lists from its catalog alone.
integrations.note: Built from committed COCI extracts into coci_college_programs and the other coci tables. The extract is a saved snapshot; a scheduled export through the Chancellor's Office dataset APIs is the proposed step.

integrations.name: C-ID approved courses
integrations.replaces: Matching a college's courses to C-ID descriptors by hand.
integrations.note: A c-id.net extract a curator supplies, normalized by the ingest script; no scheduled read.

integrations.name: COMIS Data Mart (public)
integrations.replaces: Asking for each college's program-course lists.
integrations.note: The public Program Course File in the repo was loaded by hand (PR #3239). The workflow that would fetch it on the runner has not yet succeeded: its three runs (2026-07-16) failed, and its weekly schedule is commented out until a dispatch succeeds.

integrations.name: Chancellor's Office data lake and dataset APIs
integrations.replaces: Saved snapshots: the July COCI copy and the one Fall 2025 COMIS course file.
integrations.note: The CPL Initiative will ask for API access (#3310).
integrations.agreement_name: Chancellor's Office data lake and dataset APIs

integrations.name: COMIS program awards by control number
integrations.replaces: Nothing today: CDC holds no program award counts.
integrations.note: The drafted request is not in this repo or the vault, so its link is not recorded.
integrations.agreement_name: COMIS program awards by control number

integrations.name: CCCStart JST authorizations
integrations.replaces: JST parsing, the Credit for Being You import, manual entry and batch upload into MAP.
integrations.note: Student records land in MAP, never COBI; COBI would show connection status and counts.
integrations.owner_role: Chancellor's Office General Counsel and the CCC Technology Center

integrations.name: Student information system (SIS) APIs
integrations.replaces: Not recorded per college. The district profiles (#3198) name each college's SIS first.
integrations.note: Banner, Colleague and PeopleSoft districts would connect through the Common Cloud lakes or their own APIs.

integrations.name: Curriculum system APIs
integrations.replaces: Reading course outlines page by page, and the sign-in walls in front of outlines, SLOs and objectives.
integrations.note: MAP may already connect some colleges' curriculum systems (eLumen, CurricUNET, Courseleaf CIM and others); the repo records none, so each college reads none known until MAP confirms which.
